text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for model-serving-prod in eu-west-1. Error rate spiked to 8.3% at 2026-04-12T09:12:40Z (alert threshold 2%). Paging oncall and posting to #incidents.

maria: I'm taking pager. seeing both gateway 502/504s and internal runtime 5xx. can everyone dump quick signal checks?

ash: looking now — kube events show repeated OOMKills on inference-runner containers and occasional segfault traces. attaching a snippet.

samir: log excerpt from runtime pod: 
```
2026-04-12T09:10:12Z runtime[wrkr-3]: model=rwdl-13b-quant seq_len=8200 mem=98%
2026-04-12T09:10:13Z runtime[wrkr-3]: ERROR: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) in attention_kernels.cu
2026-04-12T09:10:13Z runtime[wrkr-3]: backtrace: model_runner.cc:378 -> attention_kernels.cu:214 -> kvcache.cc:102
2026-04-12T09:10:13Z runtime[wrkr-3]: process exited with code 139
```

toya: pattern looks tied to long sequences; a burst from a single API key (acct-redacted) sent many long-context requests. also seeing correlation with older gpu nodes (gpu-a series).

oncall-sre: quick options: 1) route heavy traffic to smaller model variant 2) enforce seq length cap at edge 3) cordon suspect GPU nodes 4) rollback recent runtime image. Which do we want first?

maria: route to fallback first — lower blast radius. Ash, can we bias routing toward `rwdl-7b-quant-safe` with high weight?

ash: applying change now. curl to control plane: 
```
curl -X POST http://router.internal:8080/config -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","prefer":"rwdl-7b-quant-safe","weight":0.92}'
```

ash: pushed. edge shows new preference in eu-west-1. will leave ~8% to original runtime for probes.

samir: scaling inference-runner replicas +40% to soak load: `k scale deploy inference-runner -n prod-eu --replicas=28`

kavya: rolling a partial rollback of runtime image to runtime:v2026-03-28 for 15% of pods to confirm regression. monitoring for segfaults on those instances.

maria: also applying a gateway-level max_sequence_length=4096 rule to block extremely long requests until we stabilize. yes it's disruptive for a small set but necessary.

josh: customer impact triage: approx 1.5k failed requests in last 10m; two customers responsible for ~80% of failures. opening high-priority outreach.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLASSIFICATION: P1 (service degradation). Pager acknowledged by maria.

samir: health snapshot after mitigations:
- 5xx rate reduced from 8.3% -> 1.3% within 6 minutes
- OOM events still occurring on a handful of pods, predominantly on gpu-a nodes
- backtraces consistently reference attention kernel NULL deref when seq_len > 6000

ash: isolating gpu-a nodes by labeling and cordoning: `kubectl label node gpu-a-12 temp-evict=true && kubectl drain gpu-a-12 --ignore-daemonsets`

kavya: debug rollback pods (runtime:v2026-03-28) show no segfaults after 14m. that strongly suggests a regression in runtime:v2026-04-10. I'll collect diffs and open a bug.

toya: saving core dumps and symbolized traces to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3360000001/ — uploaded files: core_wrkr-3.gz, backtrace_wrkr-3.txt, kube-events-3360000001.json

samir: mitigation checklist so far:
- primary traffic shifted to `rwdl-7b-quant-safe` at edge (92% weight)
- gateway seq cap to 4096 enforced
- replicas +40% to add headroom
- cordoned suspect gpu-a nodes and draining in-progress pods
- partial runtime rollback on 15% for validation

maria: good. next steps: if crash rate stays low for 30m we'll prepare a full rollout of rollback. if not, escalate to infra to examine driver/kernel mismatches on gpu-a fleet.

oncall-sre: responsibilities next hour:
- (ash) maintain routing preference and continue probes
- (kavya) widen rollback to 30% if stable for 30m, else capture more artifacts
- (samir) monitor OOMs and coordinate node eviction for any remaining gpu-a instances
- (toya) check fleet driver rollouts last 7 days for gpu-a nodes and report any anomalies
- (maria) draft interim status for execs + prepare postmortem skeleton

josh: support note: impacted window 2026-04-12T09:09Z -> 09:28Z. tracking ticket SUP-66212. recommending outreach + potential credits depending on SLA impact.

incident-bot: UPDATE: 5xx rate fell below alert threshold at 2026-04-12T09:22:51Z. Incident remains open for verification and RCA. Pager continues in watch mode.

maria: thanks team — handing watch to @samir for the next shift. I'll own comms and the postmortem. main action items: driver validation for gpu fleet, stricter seq caps in routing policies, test-suite for quantized attention at long sequence lengths.

samir: taking over. quick runbook I left in the incident doc: if 5xx >3% -> flip routing to 100% fallback, cordon remaining gpu-a nodes, notify infra.

toya: note for engineers: reproduce steps include: send burst of seq_len=8000 requests to rwdl-13b-quant on gpu-a nodes; collect core dump and compare against runtime commits between v2026-03-28 and v2026-04-10.

kavya: I'll open a regression bug (BUG-78190) with stack traces and attach repro harness.

maria: closing this thread for now; reopen on any regression. great work. :pray:
